name: CES 2151 鸟击 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: your call sign is CES 2151, you are at Gate 232, you have got information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 2151，位于 232 登机口，已收到 S 情报，向武汉放行申请前往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 2151, Gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 2151，232 登机口，S 情报，申请前往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, Wuhan Delivery, information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, Z FOXTROT-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure contact 123.4, Squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，武汉放行，S 情报有效，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海虹桥，Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125。
cards.referenceText: information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 1100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, Squawk 4125, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: S 情报有效，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海，Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 1100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, pushback and startup approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, push back to taxiway Z four, facing west, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，机头朝西，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar was broke and slash bent, report it to Ground controller and request a new tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖杆断裂并弯曲，向地面管制员报告并请求新的拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, the tow bar was bent during push back, request a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，推出过程中拖杆弯曲，请求新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back with engines running on taxiway Z4, ask Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4 已完成推出，发动机运转，向地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, push back and start up completed, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，推出和开车完成，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, hold short of A7, give way to Airbus 320 coming from your right, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，在 A7 前等待，给从你右侧驶来的 Airbus 320 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: hold short of A seven, traffic in sight, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 A7 前等待，已看到相关航空器，相关航空器通过后，经 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, report it to Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，向武汉塔台报告并核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，请求核实风况。

cards.audioText:
CES 2151, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 2151，风向 200 度，风速 8 米/秒。
顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台请求更换至 Runway 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limits, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，因顺风超过起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne from Runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, one of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 Runway 18L 离地，在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况，并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 2151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, one of the engines failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 2151，我们在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，请求返场落地。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想改用 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, request change to Runway 18L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，因强顺风请求改用 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right direct to WHA, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转直飞 WHA，联系武汉进近 121.7。
cards.referenceText: change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，CES 2151。
